set.name: Wikimedia Commons, typefaces by name
set.licence: each photo's own free licence, named on its Commons page

label: The Commons category the photo is filed under. It names the photo, not the line read: a weak label.
rule: Right when the typeface, or a family the page folds into that row, is among the first rows the page shows (5); any weight counts.
crop: The tallest line of text found in the photo with confidence 0.5 or more and at least 3 characters.
catalogs: All: every shipped catalog searched as one.

timeMs.from: image bytes to ranked rows, warm
